about.legislature: Federal Assembly: State Duma (450) and Federation Council

offices.President: Elected by popular vote for a six-year term, with a run-off between the top two if no candidate wins a majority. The president is head of state, commands the armed forces and appoints the prime minister with the Duma's consent.
offices.State Duma: All 450 deputies are elected for five years by parallel voting: 225 from national party lists with a 5% threshold and 225 in single-member constituencies. The Duma passes federal laws and confirms the prime minister.
